defects.what: Shot/context mismatch: this is the onboarding 'Your city' bottom sheet, not the retaken HOME with the restructured doctor rail. The doctor cards, fee rows, and 'Delhi · change' footer are not present in the image and cannot be verified. Also the selected city shown is Kochi, not Delhi.
Caption text 'Search and hospitals start with your city filter.' renders in light grey (~#8a8a8a on white, estimated contrast ~3.3:1), below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
Footer link 'I will choose later' renders in light grey (~#9a9a9a on white, estimated contrast ~2.9:1), failing AA 4.5:1, and it is the primary escape action for the empty state.
'Skip' in the top-right sits on the grey scrim/canvas in mid-grey (estimated ~2.5–3:1 against the ~#c9c9c9 background); low contrast for the dismissal action.

measured_notes: Grab handle present at sheet top; scrim above sheet with tap-to-dismiss implied; sheet springs from bottom — behavior law holds.
City rows measure roughly 49px vertical rhythm each; row hit area appears ≥44px tall — touch target law holds.
16px left gutter consistent on rows; 'Kochi' row shows teal pin + teal checkmark as the single accent — restraint law holds on this surface.
No ellipsis or truncation visible on any city name or caption text.
'Your city' heading is the largest element on the sheet — scale hierarchy reads correctly.
Grey scrim content (illustration card, squiggle) visible above sheet; only the sheet is interactive — task stays on its screen.
non_blocking_notes: Selected row emphasis is done via bold weight + teal check + teal pin; consistent and calm.
City list is alphabetical within the shown window (Bhopal → Guwahati) which aids scanning; Delhi is not visible in the viewport — consider whether the full list needs scroll indication.
Row icons are uniform line-style pins; good rhythm and alignment across the list.
one_line: The city sheet itself is clean, calm and law-compliant in structure, but the retake failed to capture the intended HOME/doctor-rail screen, and two grey captions/actions fall below AA contrast — fail until the correct screen is supplied and the greys are darkened.
